name: Nested documents
description: Nested objects and arrays. Try completing c.address. or hover over c.name.
query:
SELECT c.name, c.address.city
FROM c
WHERE c.address.country = "US"

name: Heterogeneous documents
description: Optional fields, mixed value types, and null values demonstrate inference from varied documents.
query:
SELECT c.id, c.value, c.metadata
FROM c
WHERE IS_DEFINED(c.metadata)

name: Invalid SQL
description: Deliberate syntax errors appear in the editor and diagnostic list. Format does not repair SQL.
query:
SELECT c.name FORM c
WHERE c.price >

name: Multiple queries
description: Semicolon-separated statements share the inferred schema. Diagnostics use document-level positions.
